description: The Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore.Formatters.Xml namespace contains both types and extension methods that complements both the Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore/Cuemon.Extensions.Xml namespace while being an addition to the Microsoft.AspNetCore namespace. Extends upon XML formatters and converters in the context of ASP.NET Core for System.Xml.
